notes.title: Thanks to everyone who has already purchased the game and will buy it later
notes.content:
[b]We have prepared a fantastic update for you![/b] It was difficult, it took time, but we succeeded. You can now create very tightly connected objects while retaining all physical properties. We have achieved unique functionality by devising and programming a new way of interconnection. So far it has not been in any virtual reality game. [b]You have a great occasion to try it right now.[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36353474/5f28461d162ab1e3279b1fe1197aa015afba865f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36353474/85f98c2af44210dbf3f5032730cd777038f84a7d.png[/img][/url]

You will also find in game new free blocks and and change gravity.
